entities.summary: The Heritage at Millennium Park, located at 130 N. Garland Court in Chicago, Illinois is a mixed-use tower. Completed in 2005, with a height of 631 feet (192 m) and 57 floors, the building was designed by the architectural firm Solomon Cordwell Buenz. It is the 47th-tallest building in Chicago. Like the Legacy Tower, the Heritage preserved the façades of four existing buildings on its base.
